findings: t54's live XRPL AI Hub dashboard reports 14,736,175 all-time service payments and USD42,048.63 settled; derived mean about USD0.00285/payment if scopes match. Some displayed live settlement rows are labelled Unverified.
The directory separates 183 registered merchants from 45 merchants with live services, 131 providers and 5,258 service endpoints; 40 merchants are named and five live-service addresses are unnamed.
t54's Oct 14 closed-beta XRPL Checks batch settlement can settle many x402 requests with one Check, so service-payment counts are not ledger transaction counts.
Mastercard AP4M lists Coinbase, Ripple and t54 Labs as initial participants/supporters but is multi-rail across cards, accounts and stablecoins; no XRP-specific settlement route is disclosed.
Ripple strategically participated in t54's USD5M seed round. t54 intends to integrate its trust layer into Evernorth autonomous XRP treasury operations; this is not verified as production deployment.
Evernorth was reported to hold 473M XRP and named Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as initial partners; no amount deployed was disclosed. t54 also announced exploratory MOUs with Arco and Hecto.
